theorem lg_target {n : ℕ} (hn : Even n) : AddSubmonoid.closure (Set.range fun x => x ^ n) = AddSubmonoid.nonneg ℤ := by
  let h1 : AddSubmonoid.closure (Set.range fun x => x ^ n) = AddSubmonoid.nonneg ℚ :=
    Rat.addSubmonoid_closure_range_pow n (Nat.succ_ne_zero n) hn
  have h2 : AddSubmonoid.nonneg ℤ ⊆ AddSubmonoid.closure (Set.range fun x => x ^ n) :=
    Set.subset.trans AddSubmonoid.nonneg_ℤ_subset_nonneg_ℚ h1.symm
  have h3 : AddSubmonoid.closure (Set.range fun x => x ^ n) ⊆ AddSubmonoid.nonneg ℤ :=
    Set.subset.trans h1.symm AddSubmonoid.nonneg_ℚ_subset_nonneg_ℤ
  exact Set.ext (h2.trans h3)
